headline: v1.1.0 installed — and the confusion is fixed
note: You weren't doing anything wrong. Three things misled you: the app was fighting its own plugin for your speakers, the EQ preset was shaping your sound with nothing on screen saying so, and switched-off effects displayed '96%' as if they were on and cranked. All three are fixed and measured. Flat now reads -0.22 dB at both 60 Hz and 1 kHz, which is just your volume dial at 99.

items.text: Plugin runs inside Windows - no VB-CABLE
App no longer fights the plugin for the device
Routing controls hidden in plugin mode (nothing to route)
EQ chip in the header - names the preset, click to flatten
'Turn off' no longer uninstalls - Remove is separate, two presses
The room view is the Speakers page, faders all kept
Level meter on every speaker fader
Installer ships the plugin, shortcut points somewhere real
v1.1.0 released; update check verified end to end
Measured: Bass on +7.60 dB vs off +3.70 dB at 60 Hz
Left for you: play the AV receiver awake to confirm 8ch
